meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 要求发布前审查时,Claude 会找出自上次 npm 发布以来的全部改动,再同时派出最多 16 个后台代理分组检查,最后汇总成发布就绪报告,含版本号建议、破坏性变更清单、变更日志和风险等级。
howto.when: 仅在用户明确要求“发布前审查”(如说“pre-publish review”“release review”等)时触发;普通发布请求不会触发,会直接发布。

say.text: 帮我做一次发布前审查,看看现在能发布吗?
运行 pre-publish review,检查自上次发布以来所有改动
say.note: 会先检测未发布的改动,再逐项深度分析。

say.text: 发布前检查有没有破坏性变更,顺便给个版本号建议
say.note: 会返回破坏性变更清单和推荐版本号。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude detects changes since last npm release, spawns up to 16 background agents (10 deep-dive, 5 holistic, 1 synthesis), and outputs a readiness report: version bump, breaking changes, changelog draft, risk.
howto.when_en: Only triggers when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review' or 'release review'). Plain publish/release requests must not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review and tell me if I can publish now.
say_en.note: Claude runs 16 agents and gives a readiness report.

say_en.text: Run pre-publish review to check all changes since last release.
say_en.note: It detects unpublished changes, then deep-dives each one.

say_en.text: Before publishing, check for breaking changes and suggest a version bump.
say_en.note: Returns breaking-change list and version bump recommendation.
